title: Kick off long-running computer tasks from the Claude mobile app
description: Check progress on a running task, give Claude Cowork the next instruction, and keep work moving — all from the Claude mobile app, without returning to your desk.
prompt: Go through every PDF in ~/Documents/Invoices/March-2026 and pull out the vendor name, invoice number, date, and total amount. Put all of it into a spreadsheet called march-invoices.csv in the same folder. Let me know when you're done.
steps: Describe the task (specify files and desired output)
Give Claude context (grant folder access; no connectors required for basic file operations)
What Claude creates (processes files and delivers results)
Follow-up prompts (build on existing data, create summary files, schedule recurring tasks)
prerequisites: Computer must stay awake (enable keep-awake toggle in Dispatch settings)
Folder access granted during Dispatch setup
Optional: Gmail or Slack connectors for emailing/posting results
